Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, and presence of both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi). Return all requested columns including compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
